item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.26
item.description: - The app's name is now written ConformTxt everywhere (the wordmark stays conform.txt). - When ConformTxt is switched off, History and the paste settings gray out. Open at login, updates, Make Report and Feedback still work. - The About window, the Add app panel and ConformTxt's notes now open in front of other apps' windows, not behind them. - Only one copy of ConformTxt runs at a time: opening a new copy quits an older one that's still running.
